product_one_liner.value: Curve Dental provides cloud-based, all-in-one dental practice management software for dental practices, combining scheduling, charting, imaging, billing and patient engagement.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing/value page lists included capabilities and special startup pricing, but does not publish subscription dollar amounts.

employee_band.notes: Company profile reports 215 employees and a 201–500 employee band.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog index contains dental-practice education and product marketing rather than an engineering blog.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes a multi-module release index and detailed product how-to articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable current job board lists development, implementation and sales roles, but no qualifying AI, ML or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: Curve explicitly labels imaging as powered by Pearl AI and AI call summaries as powered by Mango Voice. These are feature-level providers, not a disclosure of the underlying model powering Curve Care+ clinical notes.

compliance_certs.notes: These are public compliance claims: SOC 2 and ISO 27001 are attributed to the hosted data-center/AWS infrastructure, not independent Curve Dental corporate certifications; HIPAA is a compliance claim, not a certification.

last_funding.notes: Battery Ventures significant equity investment announced February 8, 2018; PitchBook classifies it as Later Stage VC (Series A). The amount was not disclosed, so amount_usd is omitted.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest documented financing is February 2018, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No qualifying SDR, BDR or Account Executive title appears on the current board. Older localized SDR/Account Executive descriptions remain indexed, but their canonical job URLs return the current board rather than those vacancies.

launched_6mo.notes: Curve Care+, a native clinical AI suite with Notes+, Charting+ and Perio+, launched July 14, 2026, within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Rick Hansen was appointed Chief Customer Officer on September 29, 2026, within November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Curve job descriptions explicitly require using these systems; Salesforce, Gong and Salesloft appear in older indexed sales descriptions, while HubSpot and Salesforce also appear in the customer-marketing role.
